style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 4ft 11 Black Starburst LED Twig Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Make your Christmas truly treemendous with this starlit tree. The 1.5m Black Starburst LED Twig Christmas Tree is a delightful addition to your space. Standing at 1.5m tall, the black-branched tree with an amazing 990 micro-LEDs picks you up as the nights draw in. The twinkling effect entertains friends and passersby to celebrate the night. The indoor plug is attached to a discreet black cable that showcases the sparkle. The warm white light creates a starry aura on dark nights, providing an inspiring shine through the darkness. The optional 6-hour timer turns the lights on automatically at the same time each evening and then off again. There’s also a constant ‘on’ mode. The 990 lights stand out against the night like twinkling fireflies for an enchanting display. Make the night shine for a season to remember. Enhance the everyday and celebrate the holiday magic with the LED twig Christmas Tree.
